enable_condition: Stored integer value > 0 and unsigned renderer shader capability >= 0xffff0300
limits: Original initializer instructions, dispatcher return, integer tree getter and consumer gate executed in emulator.
Configuration return and valid one-node integer tree supplied; configuration persistence and full render frame not executed.
FXAA body is a recorded call boundary. Shader execution, render targets and multisampling configuration remain unqualified.
This contract does not establish original MSAA state and does not authorize changing the ordinary renderer MSAA choice.
